title: GRUT probe step 1: interacting charged matter (lattice Schwinger model) in GRUT's detector-history framework
model: Kogut-Susskind staggered fermions + U(1) links, open boundary, Gauss law solved exactly, theta=0, continuous time. W = 2H/(a g^2) = x sum(s+s- + h.c.) + (mu/2) sum(1+(-1)^n sz) + sum L_n^2, x=1/(ag)^2, mu=2 sqrt(x) m/g.

P-B_holdout_m_over_g_0.25_vector_binding.note: same code and extrapolation recipe as P-A, nothing retuned

predictions.P-C_gaussian_sufficiency_m0: At m=0 the continuum E-field is a free massive boson, so GRUT two-time detector histories of a smeared E-field Weyl instrument must be predicted by the two-point function alone. The max deviation of exact lattice history probabilities from the two-point (quasi-free) prediction should DECREASE as x increases at fixed physical volume and smearing.
predictions.P-D_interaction_detected_m_positive: At fixed lattice parameters, the same deviation should be LARGER at m/g=0.5 than at m/g=0, i.e. the two-point summary is insufficient once the fermion mass makes the boson interact.
predictions.P-E_backaction: Inserting the first instrument changes the second instrument's outcome distribution (nonzero disturbance) at generic T.

failure_handling: Any miss is reported as a miss; windows are not widened after the run.
